observations.claim: Coinbase announced final OCC approval for Coinbase National Trust Company on November 9; the OCC filing record identifies the charter as consummated/effective November 6, 2026.
limitations: This is a national trust-company charter, not proof of an FDIC-insured commercial deposit bank.
The charter does not establish XRP-specific custody balances, purchases, collateral or settlement volumes.

observations.claim: Eligible PNC Corporate and Institutional Banking clients in a pilot can receive USDC through Coinbase Payment APIs; incoming USDC is automatically converted 1-to-1 to USD and deposited into a designated PNC account.
limitations: Only Coinbase's announcement was located; no independent PNC release or pilot transaction volume was verified.
The described asset is USDC; no XRP, XRPL or RLUSD leg is specified.

observations.claim: Coinbase reported 10.7% crypto trading-volume market share, 12.5% assets-on-platform share, $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products, subscription/services revenue equal to 49% of Q3 net revenue, $200M annualized prediction-market revenue and 179% two-year CAGR in crypto derivatives volume.
limitations: Company-reported metrics; none is XRP-specific.
Average USDC balances are not equivalent to new net USDC issuance or XRP purchases.

observations.claim: Coinbase's Q3 10-Q says its arrangement with Circle was renewed on the same terms; Coinbase also reported Q3 stablecoin revenue and record average USDC balances.
limitations: Coinbase's recognized stablecoin revenue is not identical to Circle's distribution-cost measure.
The arrangement concerns USDC economics, not XRP demand.

observations.claim: Circle reported $73.3B average USDC circulation, $13.9T Q3 onchain transaction volume, $865M revenue and reserve income, $658M reserve income, $207M other revenue including $182M ARC presale revenue, $412M distribution/transaction/other costs and $226M net income.
limitations: Gross onchain transaction volume is not net capital inflow.
ARC presale revenue is a distinct non-recurring component; do not treat it as recurring USDC economics.
USDC issuer metrics are not XRPL-specific.

observations.claim: Circle reported $331.3M of Q3 distribution costs in connection with agreements with Coinbase and $986.6M for the first nine months; allocations depend on USDC held on Coinbase after issuer retention and broader ecosystem-growth arrangements.
limitations: These are Circle-incurred distribution costs, not a direct measure of Coinbase-recognized revenue or XRP flows.
Do not net these costs against Coinbase's reported stablecoin revenue.

observations.claim: At 14:01 UTC MorphoWatch/Morpho API showed $62.93M USDC supplied, $55.37M borrowed, 88.0% utilization, $7.56M available, 120.40M cbXRP collateral valued at $128.6M, 11,694 open loans, 6.98% borrow APY, 6.12% supply APY, 62.5% LLTV and 12.68% liquidation bonus.
limitations: MorphoWatch is an aggregator of Morpho API data; direct on-chain block-height reconciliation is still required.
This is a Base/Morpho market, not native XRPL lending.
Collateral usage does not prove new XRP spot purchases or net external capital.

observations.claim: MorphoWatch reported 1,479 liquidations in the preceding 30 days with $6.27M debt repaid; one displayed top borrower had health factor 1.03 and a 3.0% price drop to liquidation.
limitations: The health factor is borrower-specific, not a market-wide average.
Historical liquidations are not a forecast of future liquidations.

observations.claim: The three largest listed vaults supplied $44.50M, approximately 70.71% of the market's $62.93M supply; the ten listed vaults supplied $53.09M, approximately 84.36%.
limitations: Vault concentration is not the same as beneficial lender concentration; direct suppliers and vault depositors can overlap.
Derived from a single timestamped Morpho API snapshot.

observations.claim: Coinbase's proof-of-reserves page displayed 152,372,342.33 XRP reserve against 152,370,095.8 cbXRP supply, a displayed surplus of 2,246.53 XRP.
limitations: Displayed refresh time is 9:34 AM but timezone is unspecified.
This is Coinbase's own reserve dashboard, not an independent custodian attestation.

observations.claim: 120.40M cbXRP in the Morpho market divided by 152.3700958M displayed cbXRP supply is approximately 79.02%.
limitations: Source timestamps are not synchronized and Coinbase does not publish market allocation; this ratio is indicative only and is not model-admitted.

observations.claim: The pre-release CME futures snapshot at 08:25 ET showed 97.8% for a 25bp December hike and 2.2% hold. Post-release media reports described CME pricing of either 86.4% for 25bp plus 13.6% for 50bp, or approximately 90%/10%; the common signal is that a 50bp tail appeared while a December hike remained priced as certain.
limitations: Post-release capture minutes differ or are undisclosed; preserve snapshots and do not average.
Barron's and WSJ report the same underlying CME market, not independent market venues.
This is a macro policy-pricing feature, not an XRP price signal.

observations.claim: The OKX XRP-USDT ticker provider timestamp was 13:48:36.536 UTC, 1,341.464 seconds before the 14:10:58 UTC capture; Kraken supplied no provider timestamp and repeated an identical cached payload. Binance and OKX depth API requests returned HTTP 403 in this retrieval path.
limitations: HTTP 403 means the source was inaccessible through this retrieval path, not that market depth was zero.
No synchronized cross-venue post-CPI spot/depth snapshot was available.

observations.claim: Two public aggregators reported partial November 9 XRP ETF outflows of roughly $10.1M-$10.3M across three funds; XRP Insights' holdings-derived dataset has a November 9 settled row but different fund coverage and exclusion rules.
limitations: Aggregators overlap issuer source files and are not independent confirmations.
Holdings changes are not verified cash subscriptions, in-kind redemptions or spot executions.
ETF flows remain model-ineligible until fund universe, vintage, settlement method and source rows reconcile.

relationship_graph.to: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
relationship_graph.limitation: Custody charter does not establish XRP-specific balances or FDIC-insured deposit banking.
Pilot scope and volumes undisclosed; no independent PNC confirmation located.
Distribution costs and Coinbase revenue are different accounting measures.
Issuer-wide volume does not identify XRPL-specific use or XRP conversion.
Morpho is the lending protocol; Coinbase is not the protocol operator.
Requires direct block-height/onchain reconciliation before model admission.
RLUSD support on XRPL does not imply XRP is used as settlement asset.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's PNC pilot and Circle's distribution network can expand institutional USDC payment access and strengthen Coinbase's payments position.
support: PNC pilot uses Coinbase Payment APIs and USD conversion.
Coinbase reports $22B average USDC held; Circle reports $73.3B average USDC circulation and $13.9T Q3 onchain volume.
Circle reports $331.3M Q3 distribution costs connected with Coinbase agreements.
disconfirming_or_missing: Pilot transaction volume, active client count and net settlement capital are undisclosed.
USDC gross onchain volume includes transfers that are not new capital.
The described PNC pilot does not specify XRP or XRPL.
tests: Obtain PNC/Coinbase pilot volume and active-client disclosures.
Reconcile USDC issuance/redemption and onchain flows by chain and counterparty.
Measure incremental USDC balances separately from gross transaction volume.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's custody, USDC, RLUSD and cbXRP products form a multi-asset distribution strategy that can broaden access to XRP without proving net XRP acquisition or XRP settlement demand.
support: Coinbase National Trust Company received final OCC approval.
Coinbase supports RLUSD on XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Coinbase's Morpho-enabled product permits USDC borrowing against cbXRP.
disconfirming_or_missing: No XRP-specific institutional custody balance or incremental spot purchase was established.
RLUSD and USDC transfers can settle without XRP as intermediary.
Custody and collateral are not equivalent to proprietary holdings or market purchases.
tests: Track XRP and cbXRP reserve changes with exact timestamps and onchain receipts.
Measure XRP conversion routing on XRPL and Coinbase venues.
Separate custody assets, wrapped supply, collateral, customer holdings and proprietary inventory.

competing_hypotheses.claim: cbXRP-backed USDC borrowing can provide liquidity without immediate XRP sale but can also create forced-sale pressure during collateral drawdowns.
support: Morpho market has $55.37M USDC debt and 120.40M cbXRP collateral.
Utilization is 88%; 1,479 liquidations and $6.27M debt repaid were reported over 30 days.
One displayed borrower has health factor 1.03 and 3% price distance to liquidation.
disconfirming_or_missing: Market-level aggregates do not identify borrower-level net exposure or likely liquidation timing.
Borrowers can repay or add collateral; liquidation collateral need not be sold on spot immediately.
The MorphoWatch page is an aggregator; direct block-level verification remains pending.
tests: Capture exact Morpho market state, borrower health distribution, oracle rounds and liquidation transactions at block height.
Reconcile seized cbXRP disposition and subsequent exchange deposits/sales.
Model both hold/borrow and liquidation pathways separately.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The hotter October CPI release and post-release Fed pricing increase the near-term risk of tighter financial conditions, which can pressure high-beta crypto assets.
support: BLS reports headline CPI +0.4% m/m and core +0.3% m/m; both exceeded Reuters preview consensus by 0.1pp.
Post-release CME reporting introduced a 50bp December hike probability of approximately 10%-13.6%.
Cross-asset reporting describes higher Treasury yields and lower Bitcoin after the release.
disconfirming_or_missing: Post-release Fed pricing sources disagree and exact capture times are unavailable.
No synchronized XRP/BTC/UST/DXY pre/post event window was captured.
A macro surprise does not establish a causal XRP return.
tests: Capture timestamped CME futures, Treasury yields, DXY, BTC and XRP across identical event windows.
Estimate event response only after controlling for concurrent news and market beta.
Retain source-level market-pricing snapshots rather than averaging them.

competing_hypotheses.claim: November 9 ETF outflows may indicate reduced fund demand, but incomplete fund coverage and holdings-derived methodologies prevent interpreting them as verified spot selling.
support: CryptoETF and CryptoKeyhole report partial three-fund outflow observations.
XRP Insights publishes issuer-holdings-derived changes and explicitly documents exclusions/reconstruction.
disconfirming_or_missing: Fund universes differ and pending funds can materially change the daily total.
Cash versus in-kind redemptions and secondary-market trades are unresolved.
The aggregators share issuer data and are not independent confirmations.
tests: Reconcile every issuer file, NAV, shares outstanding, XRP holdings, cash/in-kind creation/redemption and timestamp.
Separate fund-level flows from spot execution and custody movements.
Keep incomplete days out of directional features.

data_quality.no_averaging_policy: Do not average market-pricing snapshots with different capture times or instruments. Do not treat aggregators of the same issuer files as independent. Preserve source-level disagreement.
data_quality.raw_source_hash_status: No manual web source was represented as a raw-byte SHA-256 receipt. Scheduled HTTP collector remains the required path for immutable raw-source hashing.

model_admission.pnc_usdc_pilot: Event record only; no pilot volume or XRP path.
model_admission.cbxrp_morpho: Raw/digest-only pending direct block-height reconciliation and borrower-level historical replay.
model_admission.coinbase_cbxrp_reserves: Raw/digest-only; timezone and independent attestation limitations.
model_admission.cpi_headline_core: May be admitted as first-release macro event values with release ID and exact 13:30 UTC timestamp; no directional implication.
model_admission.fed_rate_pricing: Not admitted until exact post-release capture times and source definitions are reconciled.
model_admission.etf_flows: Excluded while fund coverage, settlement type and holdings-vs-cash distinctions remain unresolved.

predictions.reason: No synchronized post-CPI multi-venue XRP spot/depth window and no new leakage-safe out-of-sample evaluation or shadow outcomes. Macro, institutional and collateral observations are context, not a calibrated directional signal.
alternatives: risk-off repricing from higher expected Fed path
macro tightening already largely priced before CPI
USDC/Coinbase institutional rail expansion without XRP value capture
cbXRP liquidations increasing procyclical sell pressure
partial ETF outflows reflecting fund-specific holdings changes
